topic_title: Value of ADE — Foundations for Reduced-Risk Driving
prompt: Under Texas defensive driving standards, how should a driver use a fixed roadside marker to verify a safe following distance under good weather conditions?

options.text: Match the speedometer reading directly to the distance between markers
Maintain one vehicle length for every fifteen miles per hour traveled
Accelerate until the lead vehicle aligns with the next road landmark
Count at least three seconds after the vehicle ahead passes the marker
